mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_memory (user_id, memory_type, dimension, content, source_message_id, status, supersedes_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{memoryType}, #{dimension}, #{content}, #{sourceMessageId}, #{status}, #{supersedesId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, memory_type, dimension, content, source_message_id, status, supersedes_id, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND dimension = #{dimension} AND status = 'active' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, memory_type, dimension, content, source_message_id, status, supersedes_id, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND memory_type IN ('fact', 'preference') AND status = 'active' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, user_id, memory_type, dimension, content, source_message_id, status, supersedes_id, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND memory_type = 'summary' AND status = 'active' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, memory_type, dimension, content, source_message_id, status, supersedes_id, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND memory_type = 'note' AND status = 'active' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, user_id, memory_type, dimension, content, source_message_id, status, supersedes_id, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND dimension = #{dimension} ORDER BY id ASC
